guardrail: Direct statutory facts may state what the enacted text itself sets, requires, permits, limits, or creates. They may not infer motive, distributional effect, popularity, fairness, corruption, or real-world outcome without separate evidence.

facts.heading: MODIFICATION OF RATES
facts.statement: For tax years 2018 through 2025, the bill replaces the individual rate tables with seven brackets ranging from 10% to 37%.
facts.why_it_matters: It changes the basic rate schedule used to calculate individual income tax.

facts.heading: DEDUCTION FOR QUALIFIED BUSINESS INCOME
facts.statement: The bill creates a deduction generally based on 20% of qualified business income for eligible noncorporate business owners, subject to limits elsewhere in the section.
facts.why_it_matters: This is one of the law's major new tax rules for pass-through business income.

facts.heading: OPPORTUNITY ZONES
facts.statement: The bill creates Qualified Opportunity Zones built around designated low-income census tracts.
facts.why_it_matters: It creates a new place-based tax framework rather than merely changing an existing rate or deduction.
